program_solutions:
(rule!
  (let* ((frames
           (filter
             (lambda (obj)
               (let* ((bb (obj-bbox obj))
                      (r0 (first bb))
                      (c0 (second bb))
                      (r1 (third bb))
                      (c1 (fourth bb)))
                 (and (= (obj-color obj) 4)
                      (all?
                        (lambda (p)
                          (let ((r (fst p)) (c (snd p)))
                            (= (cell-at g r c) 4)))
                        (filter
                          (lambda (p)
                            (let ((r (fst p)) (c (snd p)))
                              (or (= r r0) (= r r1) (= c c0) (= c c1))))
                          (positions-in-rect r0 c0 r1 c1))))))
             (objects g 0)))
         (sorted
           (sort frames
             (lambda (a b)
               (let* ((ba (obj-bbox a))
                      (bb (obj-bbox b))
                      (aa (* (- (third ba) (first ba) 1) (- (fourth ba) (second ba) 1)))
                      (ab (* (- (third bb) (first bb) 1) (- (fourth bb) (second bb) 1))))
                 (< aa ab)))))
         (small (first sorted))
         (large (first (reverse sorted)))
         (sb (obj-bbox small))
         (lb (obj-bbox large)))
    (grid-from-fn h w
      (lambda (r c)
        (cond
          [(and (> r (first sb)) (< r (third sb)) (> c (second sb)) (< c (fourth sb))) 2]
          [(and (> r (first lb)) (< r (third lb)) (> c (second lb)) (< c (fourth lb))) 8]
          [else (cell-at g r c)])))))
